leadText:
Goneff (Japanese: 怪盗ゴローニャ Mysterious Thief ) is a character of the day who appeared in The Wayward Wobbuffet. He is a master thief who robs banks, leaving nothing behind.

During a race to retrieve the key around 's neck, which was needed to release Ash's Pikachu from the indestructible PokéPod, Wobbuffet accidentally jumped onto Goneff's escape truck during an ongoing police pursuit. Goneff used the windscreen wipers to knock Wobbuffet off the truck, but this failed. He soon found himself surrounded by Officer Jenny and her fellow officers. Goneff tried to escape with his backup hot-air balloon, but Wobbuffet accidentally knocked him out of it and into the hands of the police.

Later, Goneff escaped this time on a stolen police motorcycle. However, Wobbuffet landed in the sidecar following a freak speedboat crash. Goneff decided to take Wobbuffet hostage, tying him with rope and holing him up in a nearby abandoned building. After Goneff was surrounded by the police, Team Rocket tried to make a deal with him, offering their escape tunnel in exchange for Wobbuffet. However, he refused and used Golem to attack the trio and later Ash's Totodile when he also confronted him. Totodile hid behind Wobbuffet to avoid Golem's , prompting Wobbuffet to use to protect himself. The reflected attack hurled both Goneff and Golem into the hands of officers waiting outside.
